The §9standard rig§r, proved on a dev server: a real quasar from a fresh 64 SM hole and a real Eye ran T6 → T7 → T8 with nothing touched and no Eye failures.
- Eye Field [1] → the Eye's Space valve (10 units into a Field hatch).
- §9J1§r: Field [2] / [1] as 15 / 8 / 0 (two emitter covers), OR Galaxy Transition [4] → 15, OR Slots [8] → 15.
- §9J2§r: Field [4] / [8]. §9J3§r: Events [1] / [2]; Slots [8] → its 75 % preset at T7.
- Transition [4] → push the next core into a plinth bus; Transition [1] → push the next chart; Status [1] → stock the charge; Galaxy Transition [1] → the Eye's Burst Control Hatch in Begin mode.
- Keep Mk I throats on the Eye's branch: they cap what reaches J1 at 24 Bu/t, so a growing quasar cannot flood the Eye.

All binary like this (AE2-friendly), T8 runs about 90 % Resonant. Analog instead: the sensor's P (inverted, ±30), W and Λ straight to J1, J2 and J3.
